import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_34/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_34/training_1.csv"

# Step 1: Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Step 2: UNPIVOT operation on both source tables
# For df0: unpivot years columns into 'Year' and 'Rural Value' (values from df0)
years = [str(y) for y in range(1960, 2018)]
df0_unpivot = df0.melt(
    id_vars=['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Indicator Name', 'Indicator Code'],
    value_vars=years,
    var_name='Year',
    value_name='Value'
)

# Filter df0_unpivot to keep only rows where Indicator Name corresponds to Rural Value
# According to source0 example, "Rural population (% of total population)" corresponds to Rural Value
df0_rural = df0_unpivot[df0_unpivot['Indicator Name'] == "Rural population (% of total population)"].copy()
df0_rural = df0_rural.rename(columns={'Value': 'Rural Value'})
df0_rural = df0_rural[['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Rural Value']]

# For df1: unpivot years columns into 'Year' and 'Electricity Value' (values from df1)
df1_unpivot = df1.melt(
    id_vars=['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Indicator Name', 'Indicator Code'],
    value_vars=years,
    var_name='Year',
    value_name='Electricity Value'
)

# Filter df1_unpivot to keep only rows where Indicator Name corresponds to Electricity Value
# According to source1 example, "Access to electricity (% of population)" corresponds to Electricity Value
df1_electricity = df1_unpivot[df1_unpivot['Indicator Name'] == "Access to electricity (% of population)"].copy()
df1_electricity = df1_electricity.rename(columns={'Value': 'Electricity Value'})
df1_electricity = df1_electricity[['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Electricity Value']]

# Step 3: JOIN operation on ['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year']
df_target = pd.merge(
    df0_rural,
    df1_electricity,
    how='outer',
    on=['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year']
)

# Step 4: Convert all columns to string type as per target schema
df_target['Country Name'] = df_target['Country Name'].astype(str)
df_target['Country Code'] = df_target['Country Code'].astype(str)
df_target['Year'] = df_target['Year'].astype(str)

# For Rural Value and Electricity Value, convert to string, preserving NaNs as empty strings or 'nan'
# To match target examples, keep NaN as empty string
df_target['Rural Value'] = df_target['Rural Value'].astype(float).astype(str).replace('nan', '')
df_target['Electricity Value'] = df_target['Electricity Value'].astype(float).astype(str).replace('nan', '')

# Step 5: Reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df_target[['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Rural Value', 'Electricity Value']]

# Step 6: Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_34/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_34/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_34/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# UNPIVOT Source0
id_vars_0 = ['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Indicator Name', 'Indicator Code']
value_vars_0 = [col for col in source0.columns if col not in id_vars_0]
source0_unpivot = source0.melt(id_vars=id_vars_0, value_vars=value_vars_0, var_name='Year', value_name='Value')

# FILTER Source0 for Rural population indicator
source0_filtered = source0_unpivot[source0_unpivot['Indicator Name'] == 'Rural population (% of total population)']

# RENAME Value to Rural Value
source0_filtered = source0_filtered.rename(columns={'Value': 'Rural Value'})

# Keep only needed columns
source0_filtered = source0_filtered[['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Rural Value']]

# UNPIVOT Source1
id_vars_1 = ['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Indicator Name', 'Indicator Code']
value_vars_1 = [col for col in source1.columns if col not in id_vars_1]
source1_unpivot = source1.melt(id_vars=id_vars_1, value_vars=value_vars_1, var_name='Year', value_name='Value')

# FILTER Source1 for Electricity access indicator
source1_filtered = source1_unpivot[source1_unpivot['Indicator Name'] == 'Access to electricity (% of population)']

# RENAME Value to Electricity Value
source1_filtered = source1_filtered.rename(columns={'Value': 'Electricity Value'})

# Keep only needed columns
source1_filtered = source1_filtered[['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Electricity Value']]

# JOIN on Country Name, Country Code, Year
result = pd.merge(source0_filtered, source1_filtered,
                  on=['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year'],
                  how='outer')  # Use outer join to keep all rows, including those with NaN

# Write output with exact target schema column order
result = result[['Country Name', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Rural Value', 'Electricity Value']]

result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_34/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
